theses.title: AI power bottleneck → next-generation geothermal
theses.thesis: AI data-center growth is tightening demand for reliable 24/7 power. Enhanced geothermal is emerging as a direct firm-power solution, while the more diversified picks-and-shovels opportunity sits in drilling, subsurface technology and electrical infrastructure.
evidence: Discovery: geothermal observed 4 vs ~0.033 expected, z≈21.62, BH-adjusted p≈0.00013.
Multiple contemporaneous documents reference a large Google/Fervo geothermal agreement.
Baker Hughes has active 2026 geothermal agreements targeting industrial-scale deployment and explicitly cites AI/hyperscale power demand.
SLB and Ormat are actively advancing EGS site development and industrialization.

companies.note: Integrated subsurface and surface geothermal technology; active 2026 commercial agreements.
Subsurface characterization, drilling and EGS development technology.
Electrical infrastructure and power distribution beneficiary of data-center buildout.
Power and electrification equipment with rapidly growing data-center orders/backlog.
Power and thermal systems for high-density AI infrastructure.
Pure-play enhanced geothermal exposure; higher upside and execution risk.
Reliable generation beneficiary; not a pure picks-and-shovels exposure.

theses.next_gate: Independent temporal replication plus valuation/timing ranking of BKR, SLB, ETN, GEV and VRT.

theses.title: Robot Learning / Physical AI → semiconductor bottleneck
theses.thesis: Physical AI and continuously learning robots require increasing amounts of edge compute, sensing and control silicon. ORACLE's live bottleneck engine identifies semiconductors as an evidence-backed tension for Robot Learning. The strongest picks-and-shovels are semiconductor manufacturing/process-control equipment, while Qualcomm is a direct edge/robotics platform beneficiary.
evidence: ORACLE live: COMPONENT:Semiconductors is EVIDENCE_BACKED_TENSION for TREND:Robot Learning with 3 independent issuer sources and 4 hard tension evidence rows.
KLA explicitly positions process control on the critical path of AI infrastructure and advanced packaging.
Lam Research states nearly every advanced chip uses Lam technology and is investing >$3B in AI-era semiconductor R&D labs.
Qualcomm has expanded into robotics and industrial AI platforms and targets $8B of Industrial/Networking/Robotics revenue by FY2029.

companies.note: Process-control complexity rises with leading-edge logic, memory and advanced packaging.
Core wafer-fabrication equipment supplier with broad advanced-chip exposure.
Broad semiconductor manufacturing equipment exposure and already appears in ORACLE tension evidence.
Direct physical-AI, robotics and industrial edge platform exposure.

theses.next_gate: Run valuation/quality/timing gates on KLAC, LRCX, AMAT and QCOM; keep bottleneck status distinct from BUY status.

theses.title: AI infrastructure → grid power capacity bottleneck
theses.thesis: Power delivery is becoming a pacing item for AI and broader electrification. ORACLE independently confirms Grid Power Capacity as an evidence-backed tension. The cleanest picks-and-shovels are electrical distribution, transformers, switchgear, grid equipment and data-center power/thermal systems.
causal_chain: Backlog and pricing power for equipment suppliers
evidence: ORACLE live classifies INFRASTRUCTURE:Grid Power Capacity as EVIDENCE_BACKED_TENSION across multiple structural trends.
Eaton reported Q1 2026 Electrical Americas orders +42% and backlog +44%, driven by data-center momentum; data-center orders were up ~240% year-on-year in Q1.
GE Vernova reported Q2 2026 orders +88% organically, with robust Power and Electrification growth and +$13B sequential backlog growth.
GE Vernova's Q1 Electrification equipment orders supporting data centers exceeded all of 2025.
Vertiv identifies power as an industry pacing item and develops integrated power/thermal architectures for gigawatt-scale AI infrastructure.

companies.note: Strongest current evidence of data-center-driven electrical order/backlog acceleration.
Electrification and power equipment with exceptional 2026 order/backlog growth.
Direct beneficiary of power-density and cooling constraints inside data centers.
Generation beneficiary; less pure as equipment pick-and-shovel.
Power availability exposure; not the preferred equipment pick-and-shovel.

theses.next_gate: Rank ETN vs GEV vs VRT on valuation, FCF growth, backlog conversion and expectation gap.

theses.title: Distributed / on-demand RNA therapy manufacturing
theses.thesis: Biopharma manufacturing may shift toward smaller, automated and distributed systems capable of producing personalized RNA therapies near the point of care. The strongest investable angle is enabling tools rather than binary drug-development programs.
evidence: therapy: observed 8 vs ~0.077 expected, z≈28.57, BH-adjusted p≈1.5e-10.
A high-economic-relevance source reports ARPA-H funding for on-demand custom RNA therapy manufacturing.
Repligen is a listed bioprocessing tools manufacturer focused on technologies used to manufacture biological drugs.
Twist Bioscience provides an industrialized synthetic-DNA platform that can serve upstream nucleic-acid workflows.

companies.note: Focused bioprocessing tools exposure; recurring manufacturing workflow relevance.
Synthetic-DNA platform; upstream enabling exposure rather than drug-program risk.
Broad enabling infrastructure; lower thematic purity but diversified capture.
Broad life-science/bioprocess enabling exposure.

theses.next_gate: Validate direct RNA/LNP revenue exposure and recurring-revenue capture before stock ranking.

theses.title: Hydrogen industrialization and electrochemical infrastructure
theses.thesis: Hydrogen remains a real industrial decarbonization theme, but project economics and demand certainty remain weaker than AI power. The preferred exposure is diversified equipment, compression, storage and balance-of-plant rather than pure-play hydrogen producers.
evidence: hydrogen: observed 5 vs ~0.163 expected, z≈11.96, BH-adjusted p≈0.00036.
Signal spans multiple research channels but includes semantic noise, so conviction is discounted.
Baker Hughes completed its acquisition of Chart Industries in July 2026, materially expanding industrial gas, transport, storage and infrastructure capabilities.

companies.note: Diversified energy equipment platform; Chart acquisition broadens hydrogen transport/storage capabilities.
Higher thematic purity and higher execution/valuation risk.
Very high risk; should remain behind balance-sheet and cash-burn gates.

theses.next_gate: Require commercial offtake, cash-flow viability and balance-sheet strength before any promotion.
